support_claim: The registry row assigns HRB 88421 to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and the commercial notes state that HRB 88421 remained unchanged when the company adopted the Oakfield Logistik GmbH name, establishing that the billing referent and the registry number denote the same legal counterparty.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity rather than mere compatibility. The packet provides a direct registry mapping from HRB 88421 to Oakfield Logistik GmbH and an explicit note that this register number persisted through the rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, corroborated by billing records using that same legal name; no competing candidates or unresolved identity caveats are preserved in the packet.
